mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where RSAFS increases by more than 1% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% YoY and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% YoY and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a disinflationary environment, which leads to increased consumer purchasing power and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL decreases by more than 0.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200k and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a strong economic environment, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 increases by more than 2% YoY.
